events.text: You're getting ready for a first date. Your palms are sweaty and you keep changing outfits.

choices.label: Take a deep breath and go
choices.resultText: The date goes fine. You laugh at your own nervousness.

choices.label: Cancel at the last minute
choices.resultText: You stay home. Relief mixes with a twinge of regret.

events.text: Your partner wants you to meet their parents over Sunday lunch. The table is set and everyone is watching.

choices.label: Bring a thoughtful gift
choices.resultText: The parents warm up. Your partner squeezes your hand under the table.

choices.label: Wing it and hope for the best
choices.resultText: Awkward silences abound. You survive on polite smiles.

events.text: You and your partner argue about money — savings, bills, and whether that new purchase was necessary.

choices.label: Sit down and make a budget together
choices.resultText: It's tense but productive. You agree on a plan.

choices.label: Storm off and spend to feel better
choices.resultText: Retail therapy feels good briefly. The argument lingers.

events.text: Your wedding anniversary is coming up. A nice dinner would mark the occasion properly.

choices.label: Book a fancy dinner out
choices.resultText: Candles, good food, and quiet laughter. A night to remember.

choices.label: Cook at home and keep it simple
choices.resultText: Homemade stew and old stories. Simple and sweet.

events.text: Your partner comes home buzzing — they got promoted at work! They're already planning how to celebrate.

choices.label: Celebrate properly
choices.resultText: You toast their success. Pride fills the room.

choices.label: Remind them you had a long day too
choices.resultText: The mood deflates. They wanted more enthusiasm.

events.text: Your child's first day of school arrives. Tiny uniform, oversized backpack, and brave tears at the gate.

choices.label: Walk them to class personally
choices.resultText: They cling to your hand, then wave goodbye. You blink back tears.

choices.label: Let the {transportMode} handle it
choices.resultText: The {transportMode} pulls away. You hope they made friends by recess.

events.text: Tension flares between your partner and one of your parents. Old habits and new loyalties collide at a family gathering.

choices.label: Mediate calmly
choices.resultText: Nobody wins outright, but the shouting stops.

choices.label: Take your partner's side
choices.resultText: Your partner appreciates the loyalty. A parent goes quiet.

events.text: You and your spouse have been talking about having another child. Diapers, school fees, and sleepless nights loom large.

choices.label: Let's do it
choices.resultText: You agree to expand the family. Excitement and nerves mix together.

choices.label: Not right now
choices.resultText: You table the idea for later. Relief and disappointment share the room.

events.text: Your spouse shows you photos of rescue puppies online. They want to adopt one this weekend.

choices.label: Visit the shelter together
choices.resultText: A wagging tail greeted you at the door that evening.

choices.label: Say the timing is wrong
choices.resultText: They closed the laptop quietly. The apartment felt colder.

events.text: Your sibling calls in tears. They need a large loan to cover rent and medical bills before month end.

choices.label: Lend what you can afford
choices.resultText: They promised to repay you. Family came first.

choices.label: Refuse — you are saving too
choices.resultText: The call ended abruptly. Silence lingered for weeks.

events.text: Someone you have been dating admits they are still paying off a hidden debt from a failed business.

choices.label: Appreciate the honesty
choices.resultText: Trust deepened, even if the future looked complicated.

choices.label: End things tonight
choices.resultText: You wished they had told you sooner. The door closed firmly.

events.text: Your spouse suggests relocating for their dream job in another city. Boxes and goodbyes flash through your mind.

choices.label: Agree to explore the move
choices.resultText: You started researching neighbourhoods together.

choices.label: Insist on staying put
choices.resultText: They nodded, but disappointment hung in the air.

events.text: Your parent hints they cannot cover upcoming medical bills alone. Pride wars with need in their voice.

choices.label: Send money this week
choices.resultText: Gratitude poured through the phone. Duty felt like love.

choices.label: Offer emotional support only
choices.resultText: They thanked you stiffly. The bills remained.

events.text: Your toddler melts down in the middle of the market — screaming, kicking, and drawing stares from every stall.

choices.label: Kneel and calm them patiently
choices.resultText: It took forever, but they clung to you and the storm passed.

choices.label: Snap and drag them home
choices.resultText: Quiet at last — and a cold silence between you.

events.text: Bedtime has become a negotiation. Your toddler wants one more story, then water, then the light on.

choices.label: Read one more story
choices.resultText: They fell asleep mid-sentence. Worth every yawn.

choices.label: Hold the line firmly
choices.resultText: Lights out. Tears, then silence. You both need sleep.

events.text: Your child has a role in the school play. Rehearsals run late and they beg you to come opening night.

choices.label: Clear your evening and go
choices.resultText: They spotted you in the crowd and beamed through every line.

choices.label: Send money for the costume only
choices.resultText: The costume was perfect. Your empty seat was not.

events.text: Report cards are out. Your child's marks are mixed — strong in one subject, struggling in another.

choices.label: Hire a tutor
choices.resultText: Extra lessons helped. They felt supported, not scolded.

choices.label: Push them harder at home
choices.resultText: Homework nights got tense. Progress was uneven.

events.text: Your child wants a birthday party with classmates. The guest list and cake budget keep growing.

choices.label: Throw the full party
choices.resultText: Chaos, cake, and a memory they will talk about for years.

choices.label: Keep it small at home
choices.resultText: A quiet cake with family. Sweet, if a little underwhelming.

events.text: Your teenager comes home past curfew, phone glowing, attitude sharp. The house feels like a battlefield.

choices.label: Talk it through calmly
choices.resultText: They rolled their eyes — then admitted they were scared you would not listen.

choices.label: Ground them for a month
choices.resultText: Doors slammed. The silence afterward was louder.

events.text: You overhear your teen planning something risky with friends. They insist everyone else is doing it.

choices.label: Set a firm boundary
choices.resultText: They called you unfair. You slept a little easier.

choices.label: Trust them and stay available
choices.resultText: They texted you later. Trust held — barely.

events.text: It is your child's first day at a new school. They cling to your hand at the gate.

choices.label: Walk them in and stay a minute
choices.resultText: A brave wave goodbye. You both made it.

choices.label: A quick hug and go
choices.resultText: Efficient — and a little heartbreaking.

events.text: Your best friend is getting married and asks you to stand with them at the ceremony.

choices.label: Say yes and plan a toast
choices.resultText: You cry during the vows. They call you family.

choices.label: Attend as a guest only
choices.resultText: Still a beautiful day — a little more distant.

events.text: A friend texts at midnight: they need to crash on your couch for a few weeks.

choices.label: Open your door
choices.resultText: Crowded, messy, and somehow warmer.

choices.label: Offer money for a hostel instead
choices.resultText: They understand. Mostly.

choices.label: Say no
choices.resultText: The silence afterward stings.

events.text: An enemy is spreading a rumor about you. People are whispering.

choices.label: Confront them publicly
choices.resultText: It gets messy — but the rumor dies.

choices.label: Ignore it and rise above
choices.resultText: Time clears your name better than shouting.

events.text: Your friends plan a weekend trip and want you in.

choices.label: Go all in
choices.resultText: Stories for years. Photos you will never delete.

choices.label: Skip this one
choices.resultText: FOMO hits when the group chat explodes.

events.text: You run into your enemy at a public event. The air goes cold.

choices.label: Offer a truce
choices.resultText: They hesitate. Maybe the war is tiring them too.

choices.label: Trade barbs
choices.resultText: Everyone watches. Nobody wins.

events.text: A friend is in a financial bind and asks for a serious loan.

choices.label: Lend what you can
choices.resultText: They promise to pay you back. You hope they mean it.

choices.label: Help them budget instead
choices.resultText: Not what they wanted — but maybe what they needed.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.resultText: Friendship cools. Your savings stay intact.

events.text: Your best friend confides a heavy secret and asks you to keep it.

choices.label: Swear silence
choices.resultText: Trust deepens. The secret sits heavy — and safe.

choices.label: Urge them to get help
choices.resultText: They are hurt, then grateful.

events.text: A close friend is moving to another city. The farewell party is this weekend.

choices.label: Throw them a send-off
choices.resultText: Hugs, tears, and a promise to visit.

choices.label: A quiet goodbye
choices.resultText: Short and sincere. You both know it matters.

events.text: Your grown child calls with big career news — a promotion, a resignation, or a bold new venture.

choices.label: Celebrate their ambition
choices.resultText: Pride poured through the phone. They felt seen.

choices.label: Offer cautious advice
choices.resultText: They listened politely. Whether they followed it is another story.

choices.label: Compare to your own path
choices.resultText: The conversation turned defensive. Old dynamics resurfaced.

events.text: Your adult child announces they're getting married. Invitations, guest lists, and family politics follow.

choices.label: Help plan generously
choices.resultText: Tasteful, joyful, exhausting. They thanked you through tears.

choices.label: Attend and stay out of the details
choices.resultText: Your seat was front row. Drama stayed backstage.

choices.label: Voice concerns about their partner
choices.resultText: The invitation still came — with colder handwriting.

events.text: Your grown child asks for a substantial loan — rent, business capital, or medical bills they can't cover alone.

choices.label: Lend what you can afford
choices.resultText: They promised to repay you. Family came first.

choices.label: Offer advice instead of cash
choices.resultText: Not what they wanted. Maybe what they needed.

choices.label: Refuse — you've retired your wallet
choices.resultText: Silence stretched between you for weeks.

events.text: Your adult child tells you they're expecting a baby. You're going to be a grandparent.

choices.label: Shower them with joy and support
choices.resultText: Tears, hugs, and already-planned visit dates.

choices.label: Offer practical help when the time comes
choices.resultText: A crib, a casserole, a listening ear — you meant it.

choices.label: Worry aloud about their readiness
choices.resultText: Their smile dimmed. You wished you'd bitten your tongue.

events.text: A grown child you haven't spoken to in months — or years — reaches out with a tentative message.

choices.label: Reply warmly and suggest meeting
choices.resultText: Awkward coffee became a long overdue talk.

choices.label: Respond but keep your guard up
choices.resultText: Small steps. Trust rebuilt in inches.

choices.label: Ignore the message
choices.resultText: The silence on your side spoke louder than words.

events.text: Your adult child announces they're moving abroad for work or love. Another timezone, another life.

choices.label: Support the move wholeheartedly
choices.resultText: Video calls and visit plans. Distance, not absence.

choices.label: Ask them to reconsider
choices.resultText: They went anyway. Goodbyes at the airport hurt.

choices.label: Plan your first visit before they leave
choices.resultText: One more week together. Memories to hold until flights resume.

events.text: Your grown child faces a health scare. Hospital corridors feel as frightening as when they were small.

choices.label: Stay by their side through treatment
choices.resultText: Sleepless chairs and held hands. They knew you never left.

choices.label: Coordinate family support from home
choices.resultText: Meals, calls, prayers. You did what distance allowed.

choices.label: Struggle and pull away
choices.resultText: Fear made you small. They noticed your absence.

events.text: The holidays approach and your grown children debate who hosts, who travels, and who brings the kids.

choices.label: Open your home to everyone
choices.resultText: Crowded, loud, perfect. The table barely fit.

choices.label: Travel to be near them instead
choices.resultText: Unfamiliar kitchen, familiar laughter. Worth the trip.

choices.label: Spend the holiday quietly alone
choices.resultText: A small meal, a quiet TV. You told yourself it was fine.

events.text: Your grown child vents about raising their own kids. They ask how you handled the hard years.

choices.label: Share honest stories without lecturing
choices.resultText: They laughed at your mistakes. Wisdom without judgment.

choices.label: Tell them they're overthinking it
choices.resultText: Unhelpful shorthand. They stopped asking.

choices.label: Admit you don't remember — you muddled through too
choices.resultText: Relief in shared imperfection. Parenting has no manual.

events.text: Your grown children raise the topic of inheritance — wills, property, and fairness between siblings.

choices.label: Draft a clear will with a lawyer
choices.resultText: Paperwork now, fewer fights later. You hope.

choices.label: Defer the conversation
choices.resultText: Awkward silence. The question will return.

choices.label: Divide assets openly at the table
choices.resultText: Tension and transparency. At least nothing was hidden.

events.text: Roles reverse — your adult child insists on helping you after a fall, illness, or lonely stretch.

choices.label: Accept their help gratefully
choices.resultText: Meals delivered, drives arranged. Love flowed both directions.

choices.label: Refuse — you raised them to be independent, not your nurse
choices.resultText: Pride slowed healing. They worried from afar.

choices.label: Negotiate limited help on your terms
choices.resultText: Groceries yes, moving in no. Compromise kept dignity.

events.text: Your grown child shows up unannounced at your door with bags and a grin.

choices.label: Drop everything and welcome them in
choices.resultText: Takeout, old photos, hours of talk. The best surprise.

choices.label: Enjoy the visit but ask them to call next time
choices.resultText: Joy mixed with mild scolding. They promised — mostly.

choices.label: Say you're too busy right now
choices.resultText: Their smile faltered at the threshold. You regretted it instantly.
